ZC2.convention: coefficient = SGN * i * sqrt(pi |n|) / L; a_n carries exp(+i k_n x), a_n^dag exp(-i k_n x) at t = 0; d_t phi = pi_0/L + R_phi + L_phi, d_x phi = L_phi - R_phi

ZC1.finite_N: [phi(x), d_t phi(y)] = i (1/L) sum_{|m| <= N_max} exp(i k_m (x-y)): every Fourier coefficient with |m| <= N_max equals i/L (m = 0 from the zero mode), all others 0
ZC1.distributional_limit: each Fourier coefficient i/L is independent of N_max once N_max >= |m|; as N_max -> infinity at fixed L every coefficient equals i/L, i.e. i delta_L(x - y) in the sense of distributions

Z1.mode_level_rule: H_int = -Int_0^L dx :L_int:; each R_phi (L_phi) factor contributes +i sqrt(pi|n|)/L a^dag_{phi,n} or -i sqrt(pi|n|)/L a_{phi,n} with n > 0 (n < 0); each P0_phi factor pi_{phi,0}/L; the integral gives L delta(sum_cre n - sum_ann n, 0)

map.box: [a(k_n), a^dag(k_m)] = 4*pi*Abs(n_a) delta_nm with a(k_n) = sqrt(2|k_n| L) a_n
map.amplitude: T = <out| Int dx :L: |in>_box * prod_j sqrt(2 |k_j| L) / L, the 1/L replacing (2 pi) delta(P_out - P_in)

ZC3.scope: mode level uses the pi-free part only; distinct labels assumed for the splitting elements; L -> L L L compared with the registered R -> R R R by parity

commutators.[pi_f0, H0 + H_int]: 0: H0 + H_int is a polynomial in {pi_f0, pi_g0, a, a^dag} only (q_f0 absent), and pi_f0 commutes with each generator
commutators.[pi_g0, H0 + H_int]: 0: H0 + H_int is a polynomial in {pi_f0, pi_g0, a, a^dag} only (q_g0 absent), and pi_g0 commutes with each generator

Z2.decomposition: both commutators vanish (derived): the problem decomposes into joint (pi_f0, pi_g0) eigensectors, in which pi_phi0/L are c-numbers
Z2.H0_zero_mode_part: pi_f0^2/(2L) + pi_g0^2/(2L) commutes with H_int for the same reason
